name: Rice rolls with squid cake
summary: Bánh cuốn chả mực is the Hạ Long roll: hot rice sheets with minced pork and wood ear, eaten with chả mực instead of chả quế or chả thịt. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, both describe that plate.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, says this pairing is the local habit.
texture: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls the sheets smooth and hot, and the squid cake chewy and crisp.
howToEat: The sheets are hot. The filling is minced pork stir-fried with wood ear. Some rolls add shrimp. Dip in sweet-sour fish sauce and eat the squid cake beside the roll.
Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, adds rau mùi and nước chấm mắm tỏi ớt, and says you can find the plate at any hour, including daytime markets.
The 13 Mar 2019 account printed 30,000–55,000 đồng a portion, depending on extra cake. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, printed about 40,000 đồng. Both stay. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Daytime local markets, and the alley by rạp Bạch Đằng. Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh also names the plate at VuiFest in phường Bãi Cháy.
seoTitle: Banh cuon cha muc — Ha Long rice rolls and squid cake
seoDescription: Bánh cuốn in Hạ Long comes with chả mực, not pork cake. The 2019 portion was 30,000–55,000 đồng and the 2021 figure was about 40,000. A current price is Check on arrival.
